working.text: November 26 to December 23, 2026. Entry is based in Dublin and writes for English-speaking developers. U.S. dates matter for readers there; Ireland has no public holiday in these four weeks.
Nov 26: U.S. Thanksgiving. Leave the day quiet. Nov 27: Black Friday. Nov 29: Advent begins. Nov 30: Cyber Monday in Ireland and the U.S. Skip sales and gift posts; the offer is already free.

Nov 30, Dec 4: AWS re:Invent. Dec 1: GitHub Game Off submissions close. Dec 4-10: Global Hack Week Open Source Week. Start Nov 27 with ways to share open-source work; skip unrelated conference coverage.
Dec 11-23: the run-up to Christmas and year-end handoffs. Start Dec 11 with a portfolio refresh for January. Christmas Day and Ireland’s St Stephen’s Day fall outside these four weeks.
